item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0026-R02-E001","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0026-R02-E002","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The Prime Minister said there was no intention to engage in war, and the Election Commission headline said a fair election was possible under the existing legal framework.","notes":["The excerpt does not support attributing the election-framework statement to the government generally."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0026-R02-E003","status":"rejected","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt does not contain the claimed voter appeal, Awami League support, or campaign activity."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0026-R02-E004","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The archive reported that four people were arrested after Hero Alam was assaulted during the Dhaka-17 by-election.","notes":["The excerpt does not support the claims about Election Commission authority or EU-delegation discussions."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0026-R02-E005","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0026-R02-E006","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0026-R02-E007","status":"rejected","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt does not contain the claimed development-budget or project-delay facts."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0026-R02-E008","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0026-R02-E009","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The Cabinet approved a draft Cyber Security Act that would repeal the Digital Security Act; a subsequent headline said the change would not substantially reduce public hardship.","notes":["The excerpt does not support claims about non-bailable provisions or thousands of existing cases."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0026-R02-E010","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0026-R02-E011","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"A report described the Ashrayan-2 project as giving transgender beneficiaries a new life in new homes.","notes":["The excerpt does not contain the allegations about ineligible recipients or resold houses."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0026-R02-E012","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"A report alleged looting or irregularity in agricultural mechanization.","notes":["The excerpt does not contain the claimed mining feasibility studies or 120-crore-taka waste."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0026-R02-E013","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The archive reported a Prime Minister's instruction to reduce unnecessary spending and stated that universal-pension funds were protected by law.","notes":["The excerpt does not contain the TIB procurement allegations or the approximately 60,000-crore-taka figure."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0026-R02-E014","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The archive reported that reserves fell to 23 billion dollars amid pressure to repay foreign loans.","notes":["The excerpt does not support a later decline to the 21-billion-dollar range."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0026-R02-E015","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"WHO warned that Bangladesh's severe dengue outbreak was a warning for the world.","notes":["The excerpt does not support claims about private hospitals refusing admissions or the government seeking international assistance."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0026-R02-E016","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The Prime Minister said at an ECNEC meeting that Bangladesh was receiving 100 crore dollars for a climate fund; Parliament passed measures prohibiting sand sales from agricultural land and imposing up to seven years' imprisonment for land seizure or false deeds.","notes":["The excerpt supports the announcements and legal provisions, not disbursement or enforcement."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0026-R02-E017","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0026-R02-E018","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0026-R02-E019","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0026-R02-E020","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"Reports described rising inflation, declining purchasing power, financial pressure on projects before the election, and the Awami League launching major projects as it began its election campaign.","notes":["The excerpt does not establish a general economic crisis or that the project announcements were development-project promises by the Awami League."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0026-R02-E021","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0026-R02-E022","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The Prime Minister called on world leaders to stop war and the arms race.","notes":["The excerpt does not support the additional claim about directing money toward children's welfare rather than weapons."]}]}
